title: Kiddie Kissed Norwegian Cheese Casserole
description: A kid-friendly Norwegian dish featuring a buttery, cheese-pull casserole with turmeric powder, made in a Dutch oven. This nut-free-friendly recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the macaroni according to package instructions until al dente, then set aside.
In a large Dutch oven, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the flour and whisk to combine, cooking for 1 minute.
Slowly pour in the milk, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens, stirring occasionally.
Remove the pot from the heat and stir in the turmeric powder, Norwegian cheese, salt, and black pepper until the cheese is melted and the mixture is smooth.
Add the cooked macaroni to the cheese mixture and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish or leave it in the Dutch oven, topping with brine-wet breadcrumbs.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.
